Name: (CP) Slime Pudding Craft of Luna
Author: LunaGlaze
Description:
Why does the Slime Hutch in Stardew Valley take up more space than a normal hut, but has less space inside? Why does the slime I raise seem to be of little use, and even attack me? Why is it that even if I use a mod to increase the internal space of the Slime Hutch, in the end it is just used to fill the Keg? Do you think this is right?
[size=4][b]I need to change all this![/b][/size]
_______________________________

[color=#1e84cc][b][size=3]Content|内容:[/size][/b][/color]
Added Slime Mayonnaise, Slime Oil and other artisan items and crafting methods. Added new artisan machines and a number of related recipes (such as turning slime eggs into more advanced slime eggs, turning petrified slimes into more useful supplies, turning other things into slime, etc.). Added flavored artisan slime jelly and various slime jelly dishes with unique bonuses that do not conflict with food bonuses.
添加史莱姆蛋黄酱、史莱姆油等工匠物品与制作方式。添加了新的工匠机器与一系列相关配方（例如将史莱姆蛋变为更高级的史莱姆蛋、将石化史莱姆转化为更有用的物资、将其他事物转化为史莱姆泥等）。添加了风味工匠史莱姆果冻与各种有着与食物增益不冲突的独特增益的史莱姆果冻菜品。
_______________________________

[color=#1e84cc][b][size=3]Config|配置:[/size][/b][/color]
Allow Slime Hutch increase the working speed of any Slime Incubators or Slime Egg-Press placed inside (reduces machine ready time).(Configurable)
允许史莱姆小屋增加放置在里面的史莱姆孵化器与史莱姆压蛋器的工作速度（减少机器准备时间）（可配置）。

After learning all the recipes of this mod, you can choose whether to enable the function that allows you to use the materials in the module as currency to purchase random monster loot once a day (compatible with monster loot added by other mods).
习得全部本mod配方后，允许选择是否启用每日可使用模组内材料作为货币购买一次随机的怪物战利品（兼容其他mod添加的怪物战利品）。

[b]Using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to set it.
使用[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]通用模组配置菜单[/url]来对其进行设置。[/b]
